     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSheafification
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjective
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The admissible Abel quotient in big-etale sheaves
    11	
    12	Etale-local surjectivity of the concrete admissible Abel transformation makes its image
    13	the full sheafified Picard Sigma target. Consequently that target is the effective
    14	coequalizer of the map's kernel pair in big-etale sheaves.
    15	
    16	This is not yet a quotient in `Scheme`: representing the kernel pair by a scheme, proving
    17	effectivity of its geometric quotient, and identifying `pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C`
    18	with the original `pic0TypeFunctor C` remain separate steps.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    32	
    33	/-- The sheafified concrete admissible Abel map is locally surjective on the big-etale
    34	site. -/
    35	instance admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap_isLocallySurjective :
    36	    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C) := by
    37	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
    38	      (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C) :=
    39	    isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C
    40	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology
    41	      (Functor.whiskerRight (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C)
    42	        uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
    43	    Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_whiskerRight_ulift
    44	      Scheme.etaleTopology (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C)
    45	  haveI : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
    46	      ((presheafToSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
    47	        (Functor.whiskerRight (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C)
    48	          uliftFunctor.{u + 1})) :=
    49	    (Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff
    50	      Scheme.etaleTopology _).2 inferInstance
    51	  haveI : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
    52	      (admissibleAbelEtaleSourceIso C).hom := by infer_instance
    53	  exact Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_comp
    54	    (admissibleAbelEtaleSourceIso C).hom
    55	    ((presheafToSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
    56	      (Functor.whiskerRight (abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C)
    57	        uliftFunctor.{u + 1}))
    58	
    59	/-- The image of the sheafified admissible Abel map is the full sheafified Picard Sigma
    60	target. -/
    61	noncomputable def admissibleAbelEtaleImageIsoTarget :
    62	    admissibleAbelEtaleImage C ≅ pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C := by
    63	  haveI : IsIso (Sheaf.imageι (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C)) :=
    64	    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_isIso _).mp inferInstance
    65	  exact asIso (Sheaf.imageι (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C))
    66	
    67	/-- The full sheafified Picard Sigma target is the effective coequalizer of the kernel
    68	pair of the concrete admissible Abel map. -/
    69	noncomputable def admissibleAbelEtaleTargetCoequalizer :
    70	    IsColimit (Cofork.ofπ (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C)
    71	      (IsKernelPair.of_hasPullback (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C)).w) := by
    72	  haveI : IsRegularEpi (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C) :=
    73	    IsRegularEpiCategory.regularEpiOfEpi _
    74	  exact (IsKernelPair.of_hasPullback
    75	    (admissibleAbelEtaleSheafMap C)).toCoequalizer'
    76	
    77	end AlgebraicGeometry

/bin/bash -lc 'set -eu
review_lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
while ! mkdir "$review_lock" 2>/dev/null
do
  sleep 10
done
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$$" > "$review_lock/pid"
release_review_lock() {
  current_owner=$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$review_lock/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if test "$current_owner" = "$$"
  then
    unlink "$review_lock/pid"
    rmdir "$review_lock"
  fi
}
trap release_review_lock EXIT HUP INT TERM
lake env lean /tmp/rev3_ajcr_root_coeq_probe.lean'
